headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals continued their winning streak, while the Houston Astros secured a shutout victory. Injuries have plagued several teams, and roster movement has been significant.

The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs. The Cardinals also secured a thrilling 7-6 win over the Reds in a closely contested matchup, with Jordan Walker leading the offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

Several teams have been impacted by injuries, including the Texas Rangers, who placed RHP Cole Winn on the 15-day injured list due to right arm fatigue. The Washington Nationals also placed RHP Jake Irvin on the 15-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. The Chicago Cubs placed RHP Edward Cabrera on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 21, 2026, with a right middle-finger blister.

Roster movement has been significant, with several trades and transactions taking place. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for Future Considerations. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Cardinals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with a final score of 3-0. Christian Walker led the Astros' offense with a 3-hit, 2-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, securing a win on the road. Patrick Corbin led the Blue Jays to victory with 6.0 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Blue Jays 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, led by strong performances from impact hitters Spencer Horwitz, Oneil Cruz, and Esmerlyn Valdez. Dylan Cease was instrumental in the win, contributing as an impact pitcher.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their recent matchup. Impact players for the Orioles included Matt Vierling, Gunnar Henderson, and Colton Cowser.

top_news.title: **Cole Winn Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers right-handed pitcher Cole Winn has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right arm fatigue.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have made a trade, sending RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
